name: Teaser
description: An advanced balance: from lying down, roll up into a V shape with your legs raised and your arms reaching toward your toes, then roll down.

source.title: Teaser on the Mat (Online Pilates Classes)
source.note: Classic Pilates mat exercise, described in our own words for this library. Stick-figure approximation.

setup: Lie on your back with your legs raised to about 45° and your arms overhead.
cues: Lift your arms, head and chest together.
Balance just behind your sit bones.
Easier: keep your knees bent, or one foot on the mat.

prescription.note: Move with your breath, slowly and with control.

keyframes.name: Roll up to a V
keyframes.cue: Reach toward your toes and balance.
